## Primary Projects
- [Zedda](https://github.com/Zedda-Labs/Zedda): High-performance Python EDA and data-cleaning library powered by a C++17 core. Designed for constant-memory profiling at terabyte scale with GitHub Actions CI/CD matrix builds and PyPI distribution.
- [Data Agnostic MLOps Pipeline](https://github.com/tirthpatel90/Data-agnostic-MLOps-pipeline): Modular pipeline automating data ingestion, preprocessing, and training workflows across CSV, Excel, and JSON with Docker containerization.
- [DevOps Utility Hub](https://github.com/tirthpatel90/DevOps-Utility-): Serverless client-side DevOps toolkit hosted on AWS S3 for configuration validation, secrets encoding, and infrastructure helpers.
- [NAVIQ](https://github.com/tirthpatel90/NAVIQ): Career guidance platform built with Python, Flask, React, SQLite, and Tailwind CSS.
- [Travel Management System](https://github.com/tirthpatel90/Travel-Management-system-): JavaScript backend web application for tours, bookings, and role-based management with SQLite and REST APIs.

## Open Source Contributions
- **NVIDIA / cuda-python (PR #2411):** Streamlined build-wheel and testing workflows on Linux and Windows for Python 3.15 compatibility; removed redundant compilation steps to natively leverage Python 3.15.
- **Serena (PR #1421):** Refactored CI/CD GitHub Actions into a parallel matrix, reducing build times from 2+ hours to under 10 minutes; automated Docker deployments to GHCR.
